flavor_text.one_line: Hinostan — aloof scholar magocracy of the synthesis; law, honor, valor.
flavor_text.one_paragraph: The Hinostan are a vigorous scholar magocracy people, a first-order synthesis of Aryastan and Yamatsu [Peer Synthesis / Scholastic]. They prize law, honor, valor, lean toward the military sphere, and field archers, heavy_cavalry, heavy_infantry. Outsiders are met as aloof; their patrons touch war.
